description: Illustrative boats beside mapped docks or inside mapped marina water; slip positions without mapped dock detail are estimates, not live vessel inventory. Dock proximity and land clearance verified against mapped source geometry.
checksScope: Dock offset applies to dock-aligned boats. Other boats are checked inside mapped marina water or an explicit working-harbor shoreline zone; individual berth positions are illustrative.

checks.berth_positions: Mapped docks, mapped marina polygons, or explicit working-harbor shoreline recipe; occupancy is illustrative

pier_notes: Fishing and observation piers use actual OSM outlines/centerlines and the existing tan dock renderer; open-line width is illustrative. No vessel occupancy inferred on fishing piers.
